detailedDerivation: A currently served old diagonal cannot be a frozen blocker, so its physical host is live after the row. Seed exclusion gives host<owner. One emitted value and row/diagonal injectivity give outdegree and indegree at most1. Strictly increasing indexes exclude cycles.

An e-edge path has e+1 live vertices if its terminal is live and e otherwise: every nonterminal is an actual current service host. Its contribution to 2I−m is e−1 in the first case and e in the second. Each isolated live vertex contributes−1.
Summing path contributions gives 2I−m=X_L+X_D−Z, including current column q among the isolates. The exact overlap equation d+I+H=2q+1 and live count m=q+1−A(q) imply Q=2I+2H−m−1.
Substitution proves Q=X_L+X_D+2H−Z−1. At q=0, Z=1 and Q=−2, so the initial constant is consistent. The proof makes no bound on long paths, dead endpoints or Z.
